summary: Reproduced the MiniMax H3 BF16 GGUF patch embedding failure through the production GGUF reader/iterator and native encoder loader with checkpoint shape (3456, 2, 16, 16) and Conv3D parameter shape (1152, 3, 2, 16, 16). Restored only the documented floating-point patch-embedding fold, interpreting the leading checkpoint axis as contiguous [out_channels, in_channels]. Native, folded, malformed, noncontiguous, and packed-storage cases are covered, and GPU Conv3D output was compared with an independent flattened dot-product reference.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through a generated BF16 GGUF and the real GGUF iterator/native load_weights path; observed checkpoint=(3456, 2, 16, 16), parameter=(1152, 3, 2, 16, 16).

53 focused tests passed, including exact real-GGUF tensor recovery, native/folded/malformed/noncontiguous/packed cases, and the assigned-GPU numerical comparison. Raw JUnit output: /job/pytest-final.xml.
89 passed, 3 skipped, and 4 unrelated existing text-encoder restoration cases failed because the test process had no initialized distributed world group. Raw JUnit output: /job/pytest-loader.xml.

gpu_execution.evidence: One visible AMD Instinct MI350X ran the exact-shape loaded Conv3D. Its output matched a separately computed flattened weight/input dot product (rtol=0.02, atol=0.25).

remaining_limitations: The full public MiniMax H3 checkpoint was not downloaded and full video/audio generation was not run; generation and output quality remain unverified.
Validation used ROCm on an AMD Instinct MI350X rather than the source reporter's CUDA SM12.x system.
No native C++ or FlyDSL code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.

Four broader text_encoder_loader tests are environment-sensitive in this checkout and failed before reaching their intended assertions because distributed world state was not initialized; focused affected-path suites passed.
